units.source_text: 朱雀院行幸那一天，亲王公卿等所有的人都随从，皇太子也参加。

en.t: On the day of the imperial visit to Suzaku-in, all the princes, nobles, and other attendants followed along, and the Crown Prince also took part.

units.source_text: 管弦的画船照例在庭中的池塘里游行回旋。

en.t: As usual, the decorated music boats circled through the pond in the garden.

units.source_text: 唐人的舞乐，高丽的舞乐，种种歌舞依次表演，品类繁多。

en.t: Chinese-style court dances, Korean-style court dances, and many kinds of songs and dances were performed one after another in great variety.

units.source_text: 乐声震耳，鼓声惊天动地。

en.t: The music rang deafeningly, and the drums seemed to shake heaven and earth.

units.source_text: 皇上想起前日试演时映着夕阳的源氏公子，姿态异常美丽，心头反觉不安，便命令各处寺院诵经礼忏，替他消除魔障。

en.t: The Emperor remembered Lord Genji at the rehearsal the other day, shining in the evening sun and looking extraordinarily beautiful, and this beauty made him uneasy; so he ordered temples in various places to recite sutras and perform rites of repentance to dispel evil influences for him.

units.source_text: 闻者无不赞善，认为此乃理之当然。

en.t: Everyone who heard of it praised the decision and thought it only natural and proper.

units.source_text: 只有皇太子的母亲弘徽殿女御心中不快，认为这是过分的宠爱。

en.t: Only Kokiden no Nyogo, the Crown Prince's mother, felt displeased and regarded it as excessive favoritism.
